## Every value belongs to exactly one class {#l3-class-boundaries }

The booklet notation $a\text{–}<b$ means $a\leq x<b$.
```{=html}
<div data-module="boundary" ></div>
```



::: {.takeaway}
No gaps. No overlaps. A clear boundary convention.
:::

::: notes
A value at13 belongs to13≤x<14, not12≤x<13. These are mathematical intervals; rounding at a physical measurement boundary introduces a separate recording issue. This example focuses on the stated numerical convention.
:::
